desc:
Welcome to +1 Wings for Soccer Cards 🦅
Fly higher, go farther, and collect as many Soccer Cards as you can! Use your growing flight speed to reach insane heights and discover new areas! 🌌
How to play:
🕊️ Fly your way across each area
⚽ Collect Soccer Cards to earn Cash
⚡ Gain +1 Flight speed every time you progress
💵 Upgrade your Soccer Cards to boost your income
🏗️ Expand your base to unlock more storage slots
💤 Your Soccer Cards generate Cash even while OFFLINE!
Rebirth to multiply your cash! ♻️
👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE Soccer Card!
